name: ON-DEM WG1 Rotating Drum Benchmark
description: Note: The author list is possibly incomplete and will be updated eventually. And please do not draw any conclusions yet from the results. This dataset contains the simulation output data used for the analysis of the ON-DEM Workgroup 1 rotating drum benchmark. The benchmark consists of discrete element method (DEM) simulations of the mixing behaviour of binary particle mixtures in a rotating drum and is part of the Open Network on Discrete Element Method (ON-DEM) initiative. The dataset contains particle-level simulation data generated using different DEM software implementations and hardware configurations. For each simulation, the particle data include: Positions: three-dimensional particle coordinates (x, y, z) Linear velocities: three-dimensional particle velocities (x, y, z) Angular velocities: three-dimensional particle angular velocities (x, y, z) Masses: particle masses Forces: three-dimensional particle forces (x, y, z) The particle data are provided separately for the two particle types used in the benchmark: Particle A and Particle B. In addition to particle-level information, the number of contacts is reported at each output time step, including: particle–particle contacts; particle–wall contacts; total contacts. The simulation data were saved at 0.1 s intervals. The provided data therefore allow reproduction of the post-processing and analysis performed for the benchmark study.
